bio: Zhine wasn't for that book learnin' at the Academy - she needed to be hands-on. To be around fellow sparkies. So she packed up her Wonder Wrench and headed to Freeport, where she met fellow energy mage, Sarienne. The two now run a custom weapons workshop, Zapworx, which is the one-stop shop for all bleeding-edge, baddie-shockin' tech.
